_comment: Conversion-only material (2026-10-16, Aether follow-up chip, item 4): it exists so the expansion jar can turn forbidden_arcanus:mortem_* armour into modular armour with its own numbers (replacements, module variants, repairs). Its ingredient named forbidden_arcanus:mortem_ingot, an item that does not exist (Forbidden Arcanus has no mortem ingot: the set is crafted from cloth and bones), so nothing was ever made of it; now "disable:this", the pack's form for that (no material claims an item by it). Its single-* attributes (*irons_spellbooks:blood_spell_power, *irons_spellbooks:ender_spell_power, *irons_spellbooks:spell_power) were removed: a lone * never applied (failure-modes section 6), and written as ** they would compound per module, 4 modules a piece (the Neptune set did: +107 % spell power a piece). Repaired with forbidden_arcanus:cloth (gen_repair_definitions.py).
